acceptance_signals: A repository-internal Python helper creates exactly one direct child of the resolved operating-system temporary directory with a short fixed-format task-owned name and fails closed when the projected build path exceeds the declared budget.
The helper rejects absolute, traversal, empty, and unsafe projected relative paths; its public representation and normalized report expose no absolute host path.
Bounded cleanup accepts only the exact verified direct-child short-root shape, rejects symbolic links and out-of-bound targets, and removes only the admitted task-owned root.
Focused tests cover creation, uniqueness, path budgeting, unsafe input, privacy-safe representation, cleanup, and cleanup rejection behavior without weakening existing tests.

One fresh short root stages exact current distribution inputs binary-safely, verifies every current overlay digest, builds exactly one wheel using the retained digest-verified local build backend with no index or dependency resolution, installs it into one fresh Python 3.11 environment, and validates version plus packaged shared-template availability.
The build/install validation uses zero network, external Codex, model, consumer form, Git mutation, publication, release, deployment, or credential operations and removes its exact temporary root.

Sanitized evidence records counts, digests needed for reproducibility, normalized outcomes, unknowns, cleanup, and denied authority without absolute paths, process identifiers, raw command output, source content, credentials, prompts, responses, or transcripts.
The v1 rehearsal evidence and all excluded pre-existing changes remain byte-identical; rehearsal v2 remains explicitly not started and not authorized.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-9e8bbf31c5a94d8aa0709e0a93602951 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Add the smallest repository-internal, deterministic short Windows build-root allocator and bounded cleanup contract, validate it with focused tests and one exact-current-source offline wheel build plus fresh install, record sanitized evidence, and stop before any external Codex or model journey. Rehearsal v2 remains a separately admitted future task.

items: A cleanup helper is destructive if its ownership and direct-child checks are wrong, so it must fail closed and receive adversarial tests.
A short root can make the observed build pass without proving that path length was the sole v1 cause or that the later automatic journey succeeds.
The repository already contains unrelated uncommitted work; the task-start baseline must preserve every excluded path byte-for-byte.
The retained local build backend is host-local evidence; its expected digest must match before use and no download fallback is allowed.
Reviewed assumption: The operating-system temporary directory is writable and short enough that a direct child with the fixed short name fits the declared build-path budget.
Reviewed assumption: The retained setuptools 84.0.0 wheel remains available locally with the previously verified digest.
Reviewed assumption: Exact current distribution overlays can be identified from Git state and staged without copying unrelated runtime or secret data.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the legacy Windows path-length boundary was the sole cause of the v1 missing-directory error remains unknown.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the automatic proposal-through-handoff journey succeeds after artifact preparation remains unknown until a separately admitted rehearsal v2.
Reviewed unknown: Behavior on Windows hosts whose operating-system temporary base is itself too long remains unknown and must fail closed rather than choose an alternate host path automatically.

title: Windows short build-root contract v1
